text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, here, ma'am! Please sit down!

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Why, thank you. Here, you can have this, dear.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Good deeds are as sweet as carrot candy… Ooh, I should write that down before I for—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-I forgot… I get dizzy when I write on the train…

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text: Oh! Are you all right?! Get off at the next station with me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Chiyono O tries to be helpful by giving up her seat, but due to her motion sickness, she ends up being the one in need of help…
